# `adt include`

ABAP include operations

```bash
adt include [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                | Description                          |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `adt include create`   | Create a new ABAP include            |
| `adt include read`     | Read source code of an ABAP include  |
| `adt include write`    | Write source code to an ABAP include |
| `adt include activate` | Activate one or more ABAP include(s) |
| `adt include delete`   | Delete an ABAP include               |

## `adt include create`

Create a new ABAP include

```bash
adt include create [options] <name> <description> <package>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description       | Default |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`        | include name      |         |
| `<description>` | Short description |         |
| `<package>`     | Package name      |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                    | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number       |         |
| `--no-error-existing`      | Skip if include already exists | `false` |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON                 |         |

## `adt include read`

Read source code of an ABAP include

```bash
adt include read [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description  | Default |
| -------- | ------------ | ------- |
| `<name>` | include name |         |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                                                                     | Default |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`              | Output metadata as JSON (no source)                                                             |         |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write source to &lt;file&gt; in UTF-8 instead of stdout (avoids shell redirect encoding issues) |         |

## `adt include write`

Write source code to an ABAP include

```bash
adt include write [options] <name> [file]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                        | Default |
| -------- | ---------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | include name                       |         |
| `[file]` | Source file path (use - for stdin) | `-`     |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `--activate`               | Activate after writing   |         |

## `adt include activate`

Activate one or more ABAP include(s)

```bash
adt include activate [options] <names...>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description     | Default |
| ------------ | --------------- | ------- |
| `<names...>` | include name(s) |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt include delete`

Delete an ABAP include

```bash
adt include delete [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description  | Default |
| -------- | ------------ | ------- |
| `<name>` | include name |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `-y, --yes`                | Skip confirmation prompt |         |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON           |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
